input.prompt: Using this soldier character only as a colour reference (olive green, dark gunmetal, small cyan accents), draw a single game prop on its own in a realistic, photoreal 3D render style with physically based materials, NOT comic or cel-shaded, no outlines, so it sits naturally on realistic jungle ground and rock textures. A flat-topped jungle rock shelf: a single solid boulder outcrop of grey weathered granite with a wide, flat, level top surface like a table, about 4 metres wide, 3 metres deep and 2.4 metres tall, with steep near-vertical rough sides and a clear sharp edge along the front top where you could grab it. Patches of moss on the top and in the cracks, damp dark streaks. Clean three-quarter front view from slightly above so the flat top and the front face are visible.
